clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A second heartbeat prowls beneath the shrine bells. Vampira follows it because hunger recognizes hunger.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, NEKOMATA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, VAMPIRA. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata laughs through the pain. “You are less boring than the dead ones.”

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A voice without lungs fills the cathedral. Vampira discovers there are hungers blood cannot answer.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, BANSHEE. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, VAMPIRA. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The song breaks into silence, but the silence remembers her name.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At the heart of Nightbloom waits a queen whose stare has outlived empires.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, MEDUSA. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, VAMPIRA.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Stone cracks. The Red Moon chooses appetite over eternity.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A paper seal flaps in the harbor wind. Something dead beneath it has been waiting for the Red Moon.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, JIANGSHI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: VAMPIRA. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The seal chars at the edges. Vampira tastes thunder where blood should be.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A pale reflection appears in every dark window of the library. None of them belong to Vampira.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, YUREI. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, VAMPIRA.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The books close themselves. Something remains standing between the words.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Hoofbeats arrive without a horse in sight. Dullahan carries her own head and a lance aimed at the first thirst.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, DULLAHAN. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, VAMPIRA. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For once, Vampira is not the only woman carrying hunger separately from her heart.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The horizon brightens. A wolf-woman waits where the Red Moon is dying, furious that night is ending before the hunt does.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, WEREWOLF. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, VAMPIRA. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dawn arrives smelling of iron, roses, and wet fur.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The wrapped queen smells like dust, resin, and a heartbeat that stopped centuries ago.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, MUMMY. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, VAMPIRA. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Vampira discovers curses have an aftertaste.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch has prepared six circles. Vampira steps into all of them on purpose.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, WITCH. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, VAMPIRA. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The library gains a new rule: never invite a vampire into a ritual.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Vampira stands beneath a sunrise she was never meant to see. The Red Moon has withdrawn, but its taste remains in every shadow. She smiles—not because the night survived, but because hunger did.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A ghost-song steals every small sound from the shrine bells. Nekomata takes that personally.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, BANSHEE. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, NEKOMATA. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The last note becomes a purr in the dark.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Every snake watches both tails. Nekomata grins at the impossible amount of attention.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, MEDUSA. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, NEKOMATA.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The snakes learn that curiosity is contagious.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The tournament closes around two predators who refuse to become prey.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata lands on her feet. Of course she does.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The harbor corpse hops in perfect rhythm. Nekomata immediately decides the rhythm is wrong.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, JIANGSHI. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: NEKOMATA. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A bell rings once. Two tails answer twice.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata notices the same ghost watching from six different shelves. Finally, a worthy stalking game.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, YUREI. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, NEKOMATA.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The ghost fades. One tail is still pointing at where she went.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan removes her head. Nekomata immediately forgets this is supposed to be frightening.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, DULLAHAN. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, NEKOMATA. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The head returns with two new scratches and absolutely no explanation.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The first sunlight finds two predators pretending they are not enjoying this far too much.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, WEREWOLF. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, NEKOMATA. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata decides eight lives is still a comfortable margin.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata immediately wants to pull the loose bandage. Mummy immediately regrets everything.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, MUMMY. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, NEKOMATA. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Two tails leave carrying one stolen strip of ancient linen.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch draws a perfect sigil. Nekomata sits directly in the middle of it.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, WITCH. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, NEKOMATA. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The spell works. The cat simply refuses to acknowledge that.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata watches dawn split into two reflections across the shrine pond. One tail curls toward home. The other points toward whatever impossible thing comes next.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings into the moonlit bamboo. Something with a thousand eyes answers.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, MEDUSA. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, BANSHEE.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The gaze breaks before the voice does.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Vampira offers immortality. Banshee already knows what forever costs.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The cathedral windows tremble long after the fight ends.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Two tails trace the rhythm of a song that should have died centuries ago.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For one moment, the dead and the living share the same chorus.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee finds an opponent with no breath, no pulse, and still somehow too much silence.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, JIANGSHI. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: BANSHEE. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The talisman trembles to a note only the dead can hear.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The library gives Banshee an echo before she sings. Yūrei is already inside the answer.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, YUREI. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, BANSHEE.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For once, silence and song agree on who won.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings across the bonefield. Somewhere in the fog, a severed head smiles back.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, DULLAHAN. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, BANSHEE. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The rider leaves before the last note finishes. Her head stays to listen.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The horizon answers Banshee with a howl that refuses to be background noise.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, WEREWOLF. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, BANSHEE. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For one impossible second, howl and wail become harmony.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings to a corpse that has already been mourned by civilizations.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, MUMMY. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, BANSHEE. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The wrappings vibrate with a melody older than the grave.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch reads an incantation. Banshee answers with a note that edits the punctuation.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, WITCH. The next sound is for you.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, BANSHEE. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Several books quietly reclassify screaming as grammar.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings one final note into the morning. This time, the world answers instead of echoing. For the first time in centuries, her song belongs to the living as much as the dead.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Vampira refuses to avert her eyes. Medusa finds the arrogance refreshing.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The blood queen learns that statues can bleed when they fall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata keeps appearing where Medusa is not looking. The snakes begin arguing about it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Even a gorgon can lose track of nine lives.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The challenger cannot be petrified by fear; she has already survived death.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The stone garden remembers the final note.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A talisman forbids the corpse from looking away. Medusa considers that an invitation.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, JIANGSHI.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: MEDUSA. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The paper survives the gaze. The corpse beneath it does not.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa can petrify flesh. Yūrei has brought very little flesh to the argument.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, YUREI.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MEDUSA.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A cracked mirror is the only witness willing to look back.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa orders Dullahan to face her. The rider lifts her head in one hand and politely complies.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, DULLAHAN.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, MEDUSA. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Even the snakes cannot decide which pair of eyes won.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Werewolf refuses to lower her eyes. Medusa refuses to admit that makes the fight interesting.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, WEREWOLF.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, MEDUSA. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The snakes learn exactly how fast a wolf can move before sunrise.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Mummy has no reason to blink. Medusa considers that rude.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, MUMMY.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, MEDUSA. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The curse survives the gaze. The linen does not enjoy the experience.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch has drawn a ward against sight. The snakes take that personally.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Look at me when I end this, WITCH.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, MEDUSA. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Every sigil ends the fight facing the wrong direction.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa walks through a garden of statues warmed by sunrise. Hair-serpents blink at the light. Nothing turns away. She decides eternity may be tolerable if it can still surprise her.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The harbor fog carries a song. Jiangshi has no lungs with which to answer, so her talisman answers instead.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The dead woman bows. The ghost bows back.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata circles the paper seal like a toy. Jiangshi remains perfectly still until she does not.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One hop lands where nine lives were certain she could not.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa commands her to look away. The seal contains no such instruction.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Stone dust settles on yellow paper.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Vampira discovers a body with no heartbeat and no intention of surrendering.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For the first time tonight, hunger has nothing to drink.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The talisman knows how to restrain a corpse. It has no instructions for a ghost.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: YUREI. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, JIANGSHI.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Jiangshi pins one corner of the veil to the floor. The rest keeps moving.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One corpse is sealed. The other misplaced her head. Neither sees a problem.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: DULLAHAN. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, JIANGSHI. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The bonefield receives another perfectly formal bow.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The moon is fading, but something feral is getting stronger. Jiangshi hops forward anyway.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: WEREWOLF. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, JIANGSHI. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The talisman survives with claw marks through three characters.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One corpse is held together by paper. The other prefers linen. Neither comments.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: MUMMY. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, JIANGSHI. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Ancient funerary traditions agree to disagree.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch wants to know whether the forehead seal counts as a spell component.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: WITCH. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, JIANGSHI. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Jiangshi declines peer review with both feet.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Jiangshi reaches the edge of dawn and stops. Her talisman flutters once, then lies still. The seal remains intact—but now it feels less like a prison and more like a choice.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Jiangshi arrives carrying rules for the dead. Yūrei has forgotten how to obey them.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The talisman falls through an empty sleeve.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings across the harbor. Yūrei answers from inside the sound.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The final echo belongs to neither woman.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata can track anything that moves. Yūrei decides not to move in ways that count.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For once, the cat watches an empty doorway first.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa commands the ghost to meet her gaze. Yūrei has spent centuries looking through walls.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The snakes hiss at a reflection that refuses to become stone.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At the last bell, first blood faces the woman who has none.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The Red Moon shines through Yūrei. Dawn does not.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan rides toward every place Yūrei is not. Eventually the ghost decides to be somewhere.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, DULLAHAN.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, YUREI. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The head whispers a road name no living map remembers.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Werewolf smells what is not there. Yūrei realizes invisibility is less useful against a nose.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WEREWOLF.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, YUREI. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The ghost leaves no footprints. The wolf follows anyway.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Mummy curses what she can name. Yūrei has been avoiding names for centuries.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, MUMMY.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, YUREI. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The curse lands on a reflection and refuses to leave.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch seals every exit. Yūrei arrives from inside the chalk line.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, WITCH.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, YUREI. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The grimoire adds a margin note: ghosts cheat.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Yūrei fades with the last violet edge of night, then reappears in the reflection of morning glass. Dawn cannot exorcise a memory that has learned its own name.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The rider follows a road that only dead women can see. Yūrei is standing in the intersection.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: For once, Dullahan asks her head which direction the ghost went.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The harbor offers a corpse that moves without breath. Dullahan respects the professionalism.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Two dead women depart in opposite directions without ever saying goodbye.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee hears hoofbeats in her own voice. Dullahan hears a road in the scream.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The bones vibrate after both women stop moving.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa has never fought someone who can choose which hand holds her eyes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The snakes spend the rest of the night checking behind themselves.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan throws her head exactly once. Nekomata interprets this as the beginning of a game.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The shrine receives a new rule: no playing fetch with cursed nobility.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At the final bell, a rider without a pulse faces a hunger without an ending.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dawn finds the road empty except for one set of hoofprints and one laughing head.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan hears claws on stone behind her. She smiles, lifts her lance, and turns the road into an arena.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, WEREWOLF. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, DULLAHAN. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One set of hoofbeats and one set of pawprints vanish into dawn.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One warrior carries her head. The other carries several civilizations of burial protocol.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, MUMMY. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, DULLAHAN. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The bonefield receives no useful etiquette guidance.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch asks Dullahan to place something personal in the circle. Dullahan places her head.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, WITCH. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, DULLAHAN. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The ritual becomes much less academic.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan rides directly into sunrise with her head tucked under one arm. The road does not end. It merely becomes visible.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The headless rider smells like iron, grave soil, and a road that never ends. Werewolf follows all three.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The thrown head bites back. Werewolf approves.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The library is full of old paper and one scent that keeps vanishing through walls.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Yūrei learns that a hunter can follow fear even when fear has no pulse.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Jiangshi does not run. She hops. Werewolf considers this inefficient and therefore offensive.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The dock has claw marks exactly one hop apart.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A scream rolls across the shrine. Werewolf answers with one of her own.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Every lantern goes dark at the same time.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa tells the wolf to kneel. The wolf has never been especially trainable.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Several snakes require a long and embarrassing recovery.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Two hunters circle each other beneath the last useful piece of moon.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nobody admits who chased whom.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Night is almost gone. Two creatures built for darkness decide which one gets the final minute.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The sun rises on a battlefield that still smells like the Red Moon.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Werewolf can smell the curse before she sees the wrappings.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, MUMMY. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, WEREWOLF. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The bandages acquire an alarming number of ventilation holes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch has a spell for beasts. Werewolf has never respected categories.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, WITCH. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, WEREWOLF. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The circle breaks exactly where the claws said it would.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Werewolf watches the moon vanish and discovers the hunt does not. Daylight only gives the world fewer places to hide.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch wants to study the funerary curse. Mummy wants fewer graduate students touching her things.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, WITCH. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, MUMMY. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The grimoire develops a permanent scarab-shaped stain.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Werewolf smells a tomb and decides the wrapping paper is optional.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Mummy adds “wolves” to an extremely old list of pests.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan asks where the head is supposed to go. Mummy refuses to answer on principle.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Neither funeral tradition wins, but both become significantly messier.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The curse requires a name. The ghost offers none.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Mummy writes the missing name in dust and waits.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Two preserved corpses meet beneath harbor fog. Archaeology immediately becomes dangerous.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The talisman now has a matching strip of linen tied around it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Banshee sings into a body built to outlast mourning.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: One line of linen loosens to the rhythm.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Medusa expects fear. Mummy has been looking at death for too long to be impressed.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Several wrappings become statues. The rest keep moving.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata has already pulled the loose end before the warning finishes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The shrine gains several hundred meters of extremely annoyed linen.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At sunrise, first thirst faces a queen preserved before half the world had names.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dawn warms the tomb dust. The curse does not fade.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Mummy enters dawn carrying nine new curses and one old name. Sunlight warms the wrappings. Nothing turns to dust. Somewhere beneath the linen, she laughs.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch asks permission to examine the curse. Mummy says no. Witch begins taking notes anyway.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The notes survive. The desk does not.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The moon is part of the formula. Unfortunately, so are the teeth.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch crosses out “obedient familiar” and writes “absolutely not.”

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Dullahan offers the ritual exactly one head and refuses to specify where it came from.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The spell works, technically, which is somehow worse.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch seals the room. Yūrei arrives from inside the book.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The grimoire now contains one page that cannot be turned.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch recognizes the talisman as magic. Jiangshi recognizes the wand as a problem.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Both forms of paperwork are damaged beyond repair.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch needs one clean syllable. Banshee gives her an entire impossible chord.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Three sigils shatter from the harmony alone.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The ward is perfect. Medusa has more eyes than the ward budgeted for.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch revises the diagram while dodging snakes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Nekomata sits on the summoning mark and refuses to move.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The spell summons exactly one annoyed cat, which was already there.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At sunrise, Witch faces the oldest hunger in the tournament and opens to a blank page.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The first line written under daylight reads: “Nightbloom continues.”

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch closes her grimoire as sunrise turns every sigil pale gold. The universe remains stubbornly intact, which means there is still plenty left to rewrite.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to VAMPIRA. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, VAMPIRA. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, ARACHNE. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond VAMPIRA, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to NEKOMATA. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, NEKOMATA. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: Try to keep up, ARACHNE. I have lives to spare.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond NEKOMATA, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to BANSHEE. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: Listen carefully, ARACHNE. The next sound is for you.

clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond BANSHEE, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond MEDUSA, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.text: Struggle if you like, JIANGSHI. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: Seal intact. Target: ARACHNE. Proceeding.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond JIANGSHI, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to YUREI. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, YUREI. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: You have been standing beside a ghost longer than you think, ARACHNE.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond YUREI, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: Choose a road, ARACHNE. I will meet you at the end of it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond DULLAHAN, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to WEREWOLF. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, WEREWOLF. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, ARACHNE. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond WEREWOLF, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A silver thread leads Arachne to MUMMY. Each guardian holds a knot in the spell binding a stranger beneath the library.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, MUMMY. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, ARACHNE. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Another knot loosens. Beyond MUMMY, Arachne follows the trembling thread toward the library.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Witch guards a locked chamber beneath the library. Behind its door, silver strings tremble around a porcelain prisoner. Arachne demands the key.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: Struggle if you like, WITCH. The silk remembers.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, ARACHNE. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The grimoire falls open. Arachne descends the stairs, carrying a blade fine enough to cut a curse.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Arachne gathers the last thread of the Red Moon. Beneath the library she finds a porcelain woman suspended by silver strings. For the first time, the widow makes a web to set someone free. One strand snaps. Then another. The doll opens her eyes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The Living Doll returns to the workshop. Witch insists a creation must obey its maker. The doll closes the door behind her.

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: Watch closely, WITCH. Nobody is moving me.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: Careful, LIVING DOLL. You are standing inside the spell already.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A crack remains in the porcelain. The Living Doll leaves it there. It is proof the choice was hers.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: MUMMY waits on the road to dawn. The Living Doll chooses to face her, with no hand pulling the strings.

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: Watch closely, MUMMY. Nobody is moving me.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Stand still, LIVING DOLL. The wrappings work better that way.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: WEREWOLF waits on the road to dawn. The Living Doll chooses to face her, with no hand pulling the strings.

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: Watch closely, WEREWOLF. Nobody is moving me.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: Run if you want, LIVING DOLL. It improves the hunt.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN

clips.speaker: BANSHEE

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: Watch closely, NEKOMATA. Nobody is moving me.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: VAMPIRA waits on the road to dawn. The Living Doll chooses to face her, with no hand pulling the strings.

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: Watch closely, VAMPIRA. Nobody is moving me.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: Come closer, LIVING DOLL. I prefer my nightmares warm.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: The horizon brightens. For the first time, she walks without listening for a command.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: At dawn, the Living Doll reaches for strings that are no longer there. Her maker is gone, her porcelain is cracked, and her next step belongs entirely to her. She leaves a silver needle on the library steps. Arachne will understand.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: And so, another name is written beneath the moon.

clips.speaker: VAMPIRA
clips.text: The night is mine again. Let the roses bloom.

clips.speaker: NEKOMATA
clips.text: There. I told you I always land on my feet.

clips.speaker: BANSHEE
clips.text: For a moment, even the grave is quiet.

clips.speaker: MEDUSA
clips.text: Remember this moment. It will never turn to stone.

clips.speaker: JIANGSHI
clips.text: My duty is fulfilled. Let the lanterns rest.

clips.speaker: YUREI
clips.text: The dawn feels warmer than I remember.

clips.speaker: DULLAHAN
clips.text: My oath is kept. I can lay down the lance.

clips.speaker: WEREWOLF
clips.text: I have earned one night without a hunt.

clips.speaker: MUMMY
clips.text: Let the sands remember who stood here.

clips.speaker: WITCH
clips.text: A perfect ending. I barely had to cheat.

clips.speaker: ARACHNE
clips.text: One last thread, and the tapestry is complete.

clips.speaker: LIVING DOLL
clips.text: I think I would like to see what comes next.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: Do mind the margins, darling. They are there for your protection.
